rustModulesDoc: Every `pub mod` in rust/src/lib.rs MUST appear here so the public Rust surface can never silently grow past the JavaScript port (the gap that let issue #166 slip). `parity: ported` rows name the feature row that proves JavaScript carries the module; `parity: rust-only` rows must justify why the module is intentionally Rust-only. The check (js/scripts/check-js-rust-parity.mjs) and the Rust test (rust/tests/unit/parity_manifest.rs) both fail when lib.rs and this map drift apart.

benchmark.reason: Criterion micro-benchmark harness for the Rust crate; measurement tooling, not a library capability to mirror.

document_formatting.reason: DOCX/PDF/markup document import and rendering built on Rust-only binary format parsers (docx_parser, pdf_parser); out of scope for the JavaScript links-network core.

parity.reason: Rust-side parity fixtures and language-target registry used to drive the crate's own conformance tests; this shared manifest plus the JavaScript checker is the cross-language equivalent.

rust_codec.reason: Derives a links encoding from native Rust type shapes (Rust reflection/derive); inherently Rust-specific with no JavaScript analogue.

storage.reason: Pluggable link-store backends including the optional doublets engine; persistence layer outside the in-memory JavaScript links-network core.

javascriptExportsDoc: Generated by js/scripts/generate-export-parity.mjs: every public export of js/src/index.js with the public Rust item that carries the same feature. rust/tests/unit/javascript_export_parity.rs references every item so the Rust build fails when one disappears, and parity/fixtures/export-parity/cases.lino compares the observable output of both runtimes.
